name: docs_search
description: Full-text search of the online Siemens documentation (TIA Portal, STEP 7, WinCC Unified, Openness API, PLCSIM, Industrial Operations X). Returns a numbered Markdown list: title, publication and version, breadcrumb, excerpt and reference to pass to docs_read_page or docs_get_toc. Use it to check Openness classes, SCL instructions or WinCC Unified SysFct/JavaScript APIs before relying on them. Set scope to a publication or topic reference to search only inside it (product and version must then be omitted). Results use compact references by default; set reference_format='url' for reader URLs. product (e.g. 'TIAPortal' for the Openness API, 'STEP 7', 'WinCC Unified') and version (e.g. 'V21') are matched against the catalog; call docs_list_publications to see valid values.

product.description: Optional product filter, e.g. 'TIAPortal' (Openness API), 'STEP 7', 'WinCC Unified'.

host.description: Documentation host; default docs.tia.siemens.cloud. Other allowed host: docs.industrial-operations-x.siemens.cloud.

scope.description: Optional publication or topic reference to search within. Pass a compact reference (<prefix>:<mapId> or <prefix>:<mapId>/<contentId>; prefixes tia=docs.tia.siemens.cloud, iox=docs.industrial-operations-x.siemens.cloud) or a reader URL copied from a tool result or the browser.

reference_format.description: 'compact' (default) for short references or 'url' for full reader URLs.
